messages:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout: service=translator, from=redwood/translate-v1.9.2 to=redwood/translate-v2.0.0, target=7% (eu-north), rollout_id=rl-4722, change_window=2026-03-25T09:00Z..10:00Z
release-manager: release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/translate-2.0.0 — major: rewrite of tokenization + improved beam pruning. QA report uploaded.
emma: quick Q — is this using the compact tokenizer with packer enabled? any runtime flags we should be aware of?
qa: yes compact tokenizer + packer.enabled=true for this canary. Preflight showed small whitespace normalization diffs on edge cases. Not blocking.
rick: SRE — what are our gates?
sre-oncall: Watch p99 latency, 5xx/504, and tokenizer.timeouts. Alerts: 504 > 0.4% sustained 8m -> auto-pause, p99 > +60% for 12m -> notify. Added kvcache.eviction alert as well.
infra: we'll pin the slice to eu-north-1a to reduce cross-az noise.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 7% in eu-north. phase=running.
emma: starting smoke traffic now. Posting sample outputs to the release doc.
qa: observed: one-off formatting oddity for list items when source contains mixed bullets. GH-4209 opened.
rick: telemetry shows a small uptick in 504s from proxy-eu-2: 0.6% -> 1.1% over 4m. Investigating traces.
sre-oncall: looking at traces — several hits show tokenizer RPC latency spikes and an increase in retry_count. Sample log:
```
[2026-03-25T09:03:12Z] req=2f9a tokenizer_rpc_ms=1350 retry_count=1 host=proxy-eu-2
[2026-03-25T09:04:04Z] req=8c7b resp_status=504 downstream=tokenizer
```
emma: similar to a regression we saw in the alpha run. Can we temporarily reduce concurrency for the canary slice and add a tokenizer soft-flag?
sre-oncall: applying concurrency override to 6 and setting tokenizer.timeout_ms=900 for rl-4722 now.
deploy-bot: updated rollout config: overrides={concurrency:6, tokenizer.timeout_ms:900} for rl-4722.
infra: applied nodepool pin to eu-north-1a; should stabilize host scheduling.
qa: re-running quick sanity — functional diffs stable, formatting bug still in logs but not widespread.
rick: 504 rate dropping to 0.5% after overrides. p99 still +30% but trending down.
release-manager: decision: THROTTLED/HOLD at 7% for 25m while we monitor. No PM rollback. If 504 > 1% for 6m or tokenizer.timeouts > 10 in 5m -> auto-rollback to v1.9.2.
emma: ack. I'll also enable a permissive-tokenize flag for canary to see if normalization is the root cause.
deploy-bot: runtime flag set: rl-4722.tokenizer.mode=permissive (canary-only).
sre-oncall: adding synthetic watch: tokenizer.timeout_count > 8 in 5m -> pager to #eng-oncall and auto-pause. Playbook linked.
qa: after permissive flag, sampled outputs show normalized spacing differences reduced. p99 down to +18% at 09:18Z.
rick: still seeing occasional backend retries on proxy-eu-2. If retries hit >5% we'll consider draining that host.
infra: prepared cordon action for proxy-eu-2; will wait for SRE sign-off.
release-manager: marking this thread HOLD at 7% until 09:25Z. If anyone needs to force a full rollback now, type exactly "rollback" here.
sre-oncall: monitoring closely. Will escalate and execute auto-rollback if thresholds cross.
emma: thanks team. I'll follow up with GH-4209 notes and a short addendum to the release doc about tokenizer flags.
qa: continuing sampling; will post any failing examples here.
deploy-bot: phase=paused (manual_hold) rollout_id=rl-4722 current_pct=7 note=concurrency-limited+tokenizer-flag
release-manager: thanks all — next sync 09:25Z or earlier if signal. :eyes:
